business_problem: Linkedcare had to run orthodontic AI inference for dental clinics on infrastructure that was expensive when idle and too slow when demand spiked. Fixed GPU servers stayed underused in quiet periods, yet peak loads still caused long request queues and weak visibility during model iteration.
solution_summary: Linkedcare moved its orthodontic AI inference stack from fixed GPU servers to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute so clinic demand could determine capacity instead of long-lived infrastructure guesses. The team packages the orthodontic model as a standard container image in ACR, and Function Compute pulls that image, attaches GPU resources, and starts the inference runtime only when requests arrive. Pre-reserved GPU instances provide a low-latency floor for real-time use, while elastic scale-out handles demand spikes without keeping large monthly GPU fleets online. The platform also contributes built-in monitoring, logs, and alerts, which matters because the model is under ongoing iteration and failures need to be caught before clinics report them manually. In practice, a front-end dental request triggers GPU-backed inference, returns a result for review, and then lets resources scale back after demand drops.

data_flow: Clinic-facing applications submit orthodontic requests, Function Compute pulls the algorithm image from ACR, attaches GPU resources, runs the inference workload, and returns the diagnostic output. Metrics, logs, and alerts from the same runtime give the team visibility into model behavior and scaling events.
business_outcome: Linkedcare cut the cost of running orthodontic AI while improving responsiveness and observability for dental customers. The company no longer has to keep underused GPU fleets online, peak queues are eliminated, and the team can troubleshoot inference problems through built-in logs and alerts instead of waiting for clinics to notice failures.

evidence_quotes: Linkedcare said its monthly GPU fleet stayed at only about 5% utilization during normal periods, yet peak loads had caused individual requests to queue for as long as 10 minutes. (original: 平峰期利用率不高，总体资源利用率维持在 5% 左右... 在业务最高峰，曾经出现单个请求排队 10 分钟的情况。)

The new flow packages the orthodontic algorithm into ACR, lets Function Compute initialize GPU instances from that image, and then runs inference on the newly created application. (original: 客户将正畸算法做成标准镜像放入阿里云镜像仓库 ACR... 函数计算通过拉取 ACR 中镜像以及底层 GPU 资源完成实例的初始化工作... 正畸计算请求发送至新创建的 GPU 应用上进行计算。)

After moving to Function Compute, Linkedcare reported about 90% lower resource cost and said clinics no longer experienced long waiting queues. (original: 相比早前的按月持有 GPU 资源，资源费用降低了 90% 左右... 门店再也没有出现长时间排队的情况。)
